name: mise
title: Mise
description: Search, install and upgrade the dev tools managed by mise.
author: lachieh

commands.name: search-tools
commands.title: Search Tools
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Search the mise registry and add tools to your global config

preferences.name: showDetails
preferences.title: Details
preferences.label: Show details panel by default
preferences.description: Open Search Tools with the details panel showing.

commands.name: installed-tools
commands.title: Show Installed Tools
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Browse installed mise tools, set global versions, upgrade and uninstall

commands.name: show-outdated
commands.title: Show Outdated Tools
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: List outdated mise tools and upgrade them

commands.name: tasks
commands.title: Manage Tasks
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Run global mise tasks in your terminal or capture their output

commands.name: outdated-tools
commands.title: Tools Menu Bar
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Show outdated mise tools in the menu bar and upgrade them

preferences.name: pruneReplaced
preferences.title: Replaced Versions
preferences.label: Uninstall replaced versions
preferences.description: Add --prune to mise upgrade, so the versions an upgrade replaces are uninstalled at once.

commands.name: prune
commands.title: Prune Unused Versions
commands.subtitle: Mise
commands.description: Delete installed tool versions that no config uses

preferences.name: pruneScope
preferences.title: Prune Scope
preferences.description: Prune unused tool versions, stale config links, or both.

preferences.name: misePath
preferences.title: Mise Path
preferences.description: Absolute path to the mise binary. Leave empty to detect automatically.

preferences.name: terminalApp
preferences.title: Terminal Application
preferences.description: Used by Run in Terminal actions. Defaults to Terminal.

preferences.name: upgradeBump
preferences.title: Upgrade Behavior
preferences.label: Upgrade past the configured range
preferences.description: Add --bump to mise upgrade and mise outdated, so a tool pinned to a range moves to the latest version and the version in your config is rewritten.

preferences.name: includeInactive
preferences.title: Inactive Tools
preferences.label: Include inactive tools
preferences.description: Add --inactive to mise outdated and mise upgrade, so installed versions no config activates are checked and upgraded too.

preferences.name: uninstallRemovesConfig
preferences.title: Uninstall Behavior
preferences.label: Remove the tool from config when uninstalling a configured version
preferences.description: Uninstalling a version that a config file requests runs mise unuse on that file instead of mise uninstall, so the tool is removed from the config as well.

preferences.name: jobs
preferences.title: Parallel Jobs
preferences.description: Number of tools mise installs or upgrades at once (-j). Leave empty for mise's default.

preferences.name: showInactive
preferences.title: Show Installed Tools List
preferences.label: Show inactive tools in Show Installed Tools
preferences.description: List installed versions that no config activates in their own Inactive section.

preferences.name: closeAfterAction
preferences.title: Window Behavior
preferences.label: Close window after actions
preferences.description: Close the Raycast window after install, upgrade and uninstall and show the result as a HUD.

preferences.name: debugLogging
preferences.title: Debug Logging
preferences.label: Log mise commands to the console
preferences.description: Print every mise command line, its exit code and duration to the extension's console.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
